---
title: "Acts"
---

# Acts

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Acts records the birth and expansion of the early church through the power of the Holy Spirit. The book teaches that Jesus continues His work through Spirit-empowered believers, advancing His kingdom to the ends of the earth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Acts 1:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Ye shall receive power</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational verse for the church's mission

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jesus' ascension and the disciples' preparation for ministry. The key verse establishes the mission of witnessing to Christ throughout the world through the power of the Holy Spirit.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Acts 2:38</div>

<div class="identifier">Repent and be baptized</div>

### Why This Verse

Pentecost response

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the coming of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost. The key verse highlights the birth of the church and the fulfillment of Joel's prophecy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Acts 3:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Repent and be converted</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to salvation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the healing of a lame man and Peter's sermon. The key verse calls people to repentance and spiritual renewal through Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Acts 4:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Neither is there salvation in any other</div>

### Why This Verse

Central gospel proclamation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the apostles' boldness despite opposition. The key verse emphasizes salvation through Jesus Christ alone.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Acts 5:29</div>

<div class="identifier">We ought to obey God rather than men</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous statement of conviction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Ananias and Sapphira and the growth of the church. The key verse demonstrates God's concern for holiness within His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Acts 6:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost</div>

### Why This Verse

Selection of the seven

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the first deacons and addresses practical ministry needs. The key verse highlights the importance of balancing spiritual leadership and service.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Acts 7:56</div>

<div class="identifier">I see the heavens opened</div>

### Why This Verse

Stephen's vision

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Stephen's defense and martyrdom. The key verse reveals Stephen's faithfulness and vision of the exalted Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Acts 8:37</div>

<div class="identifier">I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Ethiopian eunuch's confession

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records persecution, Philip's ministry, and the Ethiopian official's conversion. The key verse demonstrates the gospel's expansion beyond Jerusalem.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Acts 9:15</div>

<div class="identifier">He is a chosen vessel unto Me</div>

### Why This Verse

Paul's calling

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Saul's dramatic conversion. The key verse highlights God's power to transform even the fiercest opponent into a faithful servant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Acts 10:34</div>

<div class="identifier">God is no respecter of persons</div>

### Why This Verse

Inclusion of the Gentiles

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Peter's vision and Cornelius' conversion. The key verse reveals that the gospel is intended for all people, not just the Jews.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Acts 11:26</div>

<div class="identifier">The disciples were called Christians first</div>

### Why This Verse

Origin of the name Christian

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the church's acceptance of Gentile believers and the founding of the church at Antioch. The key verse demonstrates that God's gift of salvation extends equally to all people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Acts 12:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Prayer was made without ceasing</div>

### Why This Verse

Church prayer emphasis

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Peter's imprisonment and miraculous deliverance. The key verse highlights God's power to protect and advance His purposes despite opposition.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Acts 13:38</div>

<div class="identifier">Through this Man is preached forgiveness of sins</div>

### Why This Verse

Paul's gospel message

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins Paul's first missionary journey. The key verse emphasizes the church's role in sending missionaries under the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Acts 14:22</div>

<div class="identifier">Through much tribulation enter the kingdom</div>

### Why This Verse

Perseverance theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues Paul's missionary ministry and church planting. The key verse teaches that perseverance through trials is part of entering God's kingdom.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Acts 15:11</div>

<div class="identifier">We believe through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved</div>

### Why This Verse

Jerusalem Council

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the Jerusalem Council. The key verse affirms that salvation comes through grace rather than adherence to the Law.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Acts 16:31</div>

<div class="identifier">Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted salvation verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins Paul's second missionary journey and records the conversion of Lydia and the Philippian jailer. The key verse emphasizes faith in Jesus Christ as the means of salvation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Acts 17:11</div>

<div class="identifier">They searched the Scriptures daily</div>

### Why This Verse

The Bereans

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts ministry in Thessalonica, Berea, and Athens. The key verse highlights the importance of examining Scripture and responding to truth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Acts 18:10</div>

<div class="identifier">I am with thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Encouragement to Paul

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Paul's ministry in Corinth. The key verse demonstrates God's encouragement to remain faithful despite difficulties.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Acts 19:20</div>

<div class="identifier">So mightily grew the word of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Spread of the gospel

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Paul's ministry in Ephesus. The key verse highlights the transforming power of the gospel over individuals and communities.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Acts 20:35</div>

<div class="identifier">It is more blessed to give than to receive</div>

### Why This Verse

Unique saying of Jesus

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders. The key verse emphasizes faithful shepherding and perseverance in ministry.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Acts 21:13</div>

<div class="identifier">I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die</div>

### Why This Verse

Paul's commitment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Paul's journey to Jerusalem and his arrest. The key verse demonstrates Paul's willingness to suffer for the name of Jesus Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Acts 22:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Arise, and be baptized</div>

### Why This Verse

Paul's testimony

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Paul's testimony before the crowd. The key verse highlights the transforming power of Christ revealed through Paul's conversion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Acts 23:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Be of good cheer, Paul</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine encouragement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Paul's appearance before the Sanhedrin and God's encouragement. The key verse affirms that Paul will testify about Christ in Rome as well as Jerusalem.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Acts 24:16</div>

<div class="identifier">A conscience void of offense</div>

### Why This Verse

Paul's integrity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Paul's trial before Governor Felix. The key verse emphasizes righteousness, self-control, and coming judgment.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Acts 25:11</div>

<div class="identifier">I appeal unto Caesar</div>

### Why This Verse

Historic legal appeal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Paul's appeal to Caesar before Festus. The key verse demonstrates God's providence in advancing the gospel through legal proceedings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Acts 26:28</div>

<div class="identifier">Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous response of Agrippa

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Paul's defense before King Agrippa. The key verse highlights the centrality of Christ's death and resurrection in the gospel message.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Acts 27:25</div>

<div class="identifier">I believe God</div>

### Why This Verse

Faith during the storm

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Paul's voyage and shipwreck. The key verse demonstrates confidence in God's promises despite overwhelming circumstances.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Acts 28:31</div>

<div class="identifier">Preaching the kingdom of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Closing summary of Acts

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Paul's ministry on Malta and in Rome. The key verse shows the gospel continuing to spread despite imprisonment and opposition.
:::
